captions.detailed: A miniature home-video camcorder with a dark grey, compact rectangular body, a rigid side hand strap, a flip-out side screen, and a front-mounted cylindrical zoom lens. On the body wall beneath the screen hinge, three small rectangular control buttons are aligned. The side screen is mounted on a vertical hinge allowing outward rotation, the front lens ring rotates continuously about the optical axis, and each of the three buttons independently depresses as a prismatic control.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated miniature camcorder model featuring a main body with a hand strap, a front cylindrical lens ring, a flip-out side screen, and three small control buttons on the side. The lens ring should rotate continuously around the optical axis, the side screen must swing outward on a revolute joint, and each button should have independent prismatic movement.
captions.factory: Construct the main body as a rounded box and attach a rigid hand strap modeled with boolean-subtracted boxes. Model the lens assembly using concentric cylinders, making the outer lens ring a continuous joint. Create the flip-out screen from a thin box and mount it to the main body via a revolute joint along the vertical axis. Finally, add three small rectangular push buttons as separate prismatic joints placed on the side wall below the screen hinge.
